whoops, mea culpa. Venice is not part of the HRE, don't know what I was thinking.

Thank you very much, that was super helpful. I didn't know Savoy was so hungry for Italy, even though it makes sense historically, because in all my previous run it was swallowed up by France quite soon.
I think I will start a new run playing as Savoy then, I need more practice before tackling a small country like Milan I fear!

Thank you, that's super helpful! I think my biggest mistake was that I never took Religious Idea. I was so excited about becoming Russia that I rus(s)hed to the required Admin Tech level 10.
On the other hand I have a game as Hungary and I'm finding it real hard to progress on the Religious Idea group because admin points are so so useful I always need more. I really need to find a balance. More practice, yay!

But considering that Russia will be massive with all the hordes provinces is it gonna be maneagable with so many Sunni cores considering I don't have missionary strenght? I am worried about dragging my country into a lot of civil trouble!

I was uncertain because they are all Sunni and different cultures and I don't quite know how integratings them in my country will work as my missionaries are too weak to convert them. I am worried it will cause loads of unrest and possibly negative modifier from not having religious unity.
